description.zh: 输入任一命题，通过第一性原理、反向拆解、极端压力测试与决策边界四重视角，层层剥离认知盲区。
description.en: Input any proposition and dismantle cognitive blind spots through First-Principles, Deconstruction, Stress-Testing, and Decision Boundaries.

releaseNotes.zh: 大幅升级推演等待体验：新增四维透镜动态推演流水线与极光动效、毫秒级跑秒计时器、阶段性进度灯点亮反馈、智能松散JSON自愈解析，以及随时取消推演功能，告别黑盒等待焦虑。
releaseNotes.en: Major UX upgrade: Added 4-lens dynamic inference pipeline with aurora animations, real-time timer badge, step-by-step progress lights, relaxed JSON repair parser, and instant cancel option.
